review.tagline: Desktop app that runs local models or cloud APIs, with a local server
review.summary: Jan is a Tauri desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux that downloads LLMs from Hugging Face and runs them through a bundled llama.cpp engine. It can also connect to cloud providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral and Groq. It exposes an OpenAI-compatible API at localhost:1337 and supports MCP for agent tools.
review.audience: Users who want a local ChatGPT-style desktop app with a local API
strengths: Runs local models and cloud providers from one app
OpenAI-compatible local server at localhost:1337 for other applications
MCP integration for agentic tool use
Engine variants for CPU, Vulkan, Metal, CUDA and ROCm builds
weaknesses: Desktop only; no Docker image or multi-user web deployment
README says Apache 2.0, but license detection reports NOASSERTION
Source build needs Node, Yarn, Rust; Windows also needs LLVM, Ninja, CMake
Linux Arm64 is a linked how-to, not a packaged download
needs: Models: GGUF via llama.cpp, Hugging Face models, OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral
